title: Legend of Range Four Harry, the glowing radioactive horse

tellings.quote: The range, the legend of range for Harry was that there was this giant white radioactive horse

related.note: This is the same giant white horse as the Range Four Harry legend in #1, but Hall explains it as the tall whites' suit force fields merging, not a radioactive horse.

plain: Charles Hall, a man who says he worked on the Air Force gunnery ranges near Indian Springs, Nevada, in the mid 1960s, tells of a legend the men there passed around. According to Hall, the story on Range Four was of a giant white horse, glowing and radioactive, nicknamed Harry. He tells it as part of his wider account of tall white beings he says he met on those ranges, hinting that the legend may have grown out of them.
